text:
Michael Amadio has had a winding career: a third-round pick by Los Angeles, stops in Toronto and Vegas (a 2023 Stanley Cup), and a second stint in Ottawa. This season has started as well as any, with 7 goals and 13 points in 21 games, and the timing matters. The Ottawa Citizen reported that he hired agent Andy Scott with extension talks looming.

Some of it is real. His chances are up to 0.81 expected goals per 60 minutes from 0.64 last season, and his ice time has climbed to 17.3 minutes over his last ten games, in which he has 9 points. Our wins-added measure, which credits goals by how much they swung a game, ranks him 47th among 530 skaters: his goals have swung games more than his chances would suggest.

Some of it is shooting. His 7 goals came on 4.66 expected goals, and his 25% shooting is well above his usual range of 12.5% to 17.7%. TSN's headline quoted him: "Fortunate enough to be getting some chances recently and capitalising on them." Evolving-Hockey had him worth 1.7 wins above replacement last season, with strong defensive impact. That part doesn't depend on the shooting.
headline: Amadio is finishing everything in a contract year
